analysis.strategic_adjustment: Consider expanding portfolio with more intimate architectural details - doorways, thresholds, transitional spaces. Test similar domestic subjects while maintaining artistic vision.
analysis.confidence_impact: Mild positive - single data point suggests promising direction but requires validation through repeated results before major strategic shift.
analysis.emotional_warning: Curiosity is productive, but guard against chasing engagement metrics at expense of artistic integrity. One viral post does not constitute a pattern.
analysis.next_best_action: Create 2-3 more pieces exploring doorways/thresholds with varied approaches. Track engagement comparatively. Document whether pattern holds or if this was anomaly.
